alerts.name: Modern Web Application
alerts.desc: The application appears to be a modern web application. If you need to explore it automatically then the Client Spider may well be more effective than the standard one.

instances.evidence:
<script>
      // Apply the saved theme and language before the first paint, so there is
      // no flash of the wrong theme. Mirrors src/stores/preferences.ts.
      (function () {
        try {
          var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('campus-tab:preferences') || '{}').state || {};
          var theme = saved.theme || 'system';
          if (theme === 'system') {
            theme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
          }
          document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
        } catch (e) {
          /* storage blocked: the CSS falls back to the device setting */
        }
      })();
    </script>
